test a weighted combination using inverse_error weights to see if a model‑centric weighting improves over the simple mean in this highly seasonal, unstable ranking series.
Test a per‑horizon weighted scheme using softmax of inverse error to see if a more dynamic weighting improves over the flat mean.
Test a robust median combination to counter unstable ranking and correlated errors in this highly seasonal series.
The series has strong seasonality and unstable ranking, so a robust trimmed mean could reduce influence of outlier models and improve over plain mean.
DBA on the full pool to adaptively weight models across horizons
Test a per‑horizon weighted scheme on the full pool to see if using the best‑per‑horizon mask improves over the flat mean, motivated by the unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
Test a robust median over the stable 7‑model pool to see if a simple robust combiner beats the trimmed‑mean baseline.
